store.description: The one-year birthday bash for Baldi's Basics. Collect the notebooks, survive Baldi's math quiz and dodge the rest of the school in this celebratory remix of the original.
features: Collect notebooks while Baldi hunts you down
Run, hide and use items to slow him
WASD + mouse, Shift to run, E to use
Embedded client — no download, no account
Reload and Open-in-Browser toolbar if the frame is blocked
